name: Yamaha RD250 / RD125
engine: 123 or 247 cc air-cooled reed-valve two-stroke twin, Autolube oil injection
intro: The smaller RDs. Reed-valve two-stroke twins with Autolube and points.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
